desc: negative: Try to delete ets drr class' qdisc while still keeping it in the active list
pre: ip link add dummy1 type dummy && ip link set dummy1 up
ip link set dev dummy1 up || true
ip addr add 10.10.11.10/24 dev dummy1 || true
tc qdisc add dev dummy1 root handle 1: ets bands 2 strict 1
tc qdisc add dev dummy1 parent 1:2 handle 20: tbf rate 8bit burst 100b latency 1s
tc filter add dev dummy1 parent 1: basic classid 1:2
tc qdisc change dev dummy1 root handle 1: ets bands 2 strict 2
tc qdisc change dev dummy1 root handle 1: ets bands 1 strict 1

readback.cmd: tc -s -j qdisc ls dev dummy1 root
readback.name: verify
